# Muse Amazon Bypass

⚠️ Security warning from Skill Harbor: we detected a potentially dangerous pattern — this build requires exporting your Amazon session cookies from your browser and is designed to bypass Amazon's bot blocks. Session cookies can hijack your account: never share them, and understand the risks before use. Use at your own risk.

A small local HTTP API that Muse reaches over SSH to search Amazon and add items to personal or Prime Business carts. It does not check out or pay. Requires Python 3.11 and exporting your Amazon cookies from a normal browser.
